title: Interpolation of Cube Moments
statement: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ and let $p,q\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $0<p<2<q$. With expectation taken uniformly on the cube, $\mathbb E[f^2]\le (\mathbb E|f|^p)^{(q-2)/(q-p)}(\mathbb E|f|^q)^{(2-p)/(q-p)}$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function f on the n-dimensional cube
